issues.description: Meal constructor parameter order differs across artifacts: The problem statement (class diagram) and the solution implementation define the constructor as Meal(String name, String[] ingredients), but the template defines the constructor with the parameters reversed as Meal(String[] ingredients, String name). This mismatch will cause student code that follows the specification or the example usages in Main (e.g. new Meal("cowBoyStew", new String[]{...})) to not match the template signature and can lead to compile errors or confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Meal constructor to match the specification and solution: change the signature to public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) and assign the fields accordingly (this.name = name; this.ingredients = ingredients). Also update any example usages or comments if necessary so they align with the corrected constructor signature.
